description.value:
Somewhere, a room is being kept ready. It is being kept ready for you.

Gift — Once per day, when you would die, you don't — not yet. You stabilize automatically at 1 HP, no check required, regardless of the damage that would have killed you. Tithe — The Teratoma isn't saving you for free. It's deciding when your account comes due, and the GM keeps that clock hidden. When it fills, the Teratoma calls you home — how and when is the GM's to decide, and nothing removes the trait or stops the clock.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Once per day, when you would die, you don't -- you stabilize automatically at 1 HP" has no confirmed rule-element hook: like The Held Breath and The Open Account, this overrides pf2e's built-in dying sequence, and no rule element for auto-stabilizing at a specific HP value in place of dying was found in pf2e-source.
